name: Auxiliary Vision Inspection Unit
summary: Through automatic flipping and image recognition, it assists or replaces manual inspection of product appearance quality, solving the difficulty of manually flipping heavy products.
contentHtml:
The auxiliary visual inspection unit is an automated auxiliary device developed by TXAM for product quality inspection.

Working Principle

The equipment automatically flips products and works with the image recognition system to assist in completing product appearance quality inspection. It effectively solves the difficulty of manually flipping heavy products.

Technical Advantages

  • Automatic flipping function, solving the difficulty of flipping heavy products
  • Works with vision systems to improve inspection accuracy
  • Significantly enhances appearance inspection efficiency
  • Reduces employee labor intensity
